validation.pixel_privacy: Review required; decode success does not establish cover order or privacy.

original.review_status: unviewed; awaiting sole-decoder immutable derivative handoff

original_metadata_scope: Original manifest record copied without reinterpretation. Historical pixel_reviewer fields are assignment metadata, not evidence of completed visual inspection. Runtime UTC/checkpoint values are not aligned to frame PTS by this review.

prior_review_evidence.attribution_note: Earlier debug2 completed recordings remain attributed to /root/review_game and were not re-viewed or modified. This seascape recording was wholly unviewed in that checkpoint; all 40 new direct representatives are attributed to /root/pixel_d2_sea.

identity_validation.exact_repeat_method: Compare actual WebP file bytes to the directly viewed reference, in addition to size and SHA-256; no visual-similarity matching.

method: Directly inspect every previously unviewed distinct lossless WebP with view_image detail original at full decoded 1600x720 resolution. Record observations after display. Retain every original frame identity; inherit observations for byte-identical repeats only after exact byte equality. No crops, collages, resizing, new decoding, capture, builds, downloads, native/device execution or product edits.
conclusion: No exposed private card faces were observed in any of the 87 retained source-frame identities. Opening/closing views show opaque dark content or privacy covers; returned Standard portrait shows a complete concealment panel. Native landscape hand/table content is outside the visible content area, so these pixels do not establish its offscreen concealed state or reachability. Two visible clipping findings remain documented.
qualification_scope: Recorded-frame pixel evidence only; this is not gameplay, complete accessibility, continuous privacy, native/device performance, physical network, signing or store qualification. No preference or removal decision between the two real Godot styles is made.

findings.description: Native Table ready landscape has a fully readable Show hand control, but the lower Play 1–3 cards face down instruction is vertically clipped and the hand/table content is below the visible area.
findings.impact_scope: Full lower game content and offscreen hand concealment cannot be assessed. A right-side scroll indicator is visible; these stills do not prove scrolling, reachability or inaccessibility.

findings.description: Returned Standard portrait fits the entire Show hand and For your eyes only concealment panel, but the helper line beginning Wild cards always match is vertically clipped at the lower content boundary.
findings.impact_scope: Clipping is visible; scrolling and reachability of the remaining helper text were not exercised.

limits: All retained decoded frame identities are represented, but encoded still coverage does not establish continuous on-device privacy between frames, outside the clip or in offscreen content.

Original packet PTS and 1/90000 time base establish media order only. No input DOWN/UP, host UTC, device monotonic clock or test-event alignment is inferred. Onscreen clock text and copied runtime metadata are not used for alignment.
Native landscape lower hand/table area is not visible, so absence of visible private faces cannot prove offscreen concealment.
Clipped text, visible controls and scroll indicators do not establish input hit targets, successful interaction, scrolling or lower-content reachability.
Portrait content is the original centered projection within the fixed 1600x720 recording canvas; no image transform was applied by this reviewer.
Visible decorative card backs and public Star table symbols are not treated as private-card exposure.
No native run, gameplay scenario, device/store signing, physical network test or performance qualification was executed by this reviewer.
